svg.title: Глава 9 — подробная шпаргалка
svg.desc: Detailed Linux networking summary: layers, addressing, routing, DNS, transport, DHCP, routing, NAT, firewall, ARP/NDP and Wi-Fi.
svg.text: layers · IPv4/IPv6 · routing · DNS · TCP/UDP · DHCP · router/NAT · firewall · ARP/NDP · Wi-Fi

text.tspan: Physical/link: Ethernet or Wi-Fi + MAC.
Network: IPv4/IPv6 addresses and routes.
Transport: TCP/UDP + ports.
Name/application logic sits above.
Troubleshoot from the first failed lower layer.
IPv4 address + CIDR prefix define subnet context.
IPv6 uses 128-bit addresses and link-local state.
Specific matching route takes precedence.
Default route catches otherwise unmatched traffic.
Gateway must be reachable through a local network.
ip address show → interface/address state.
ip route show → kernel routing state.
ping → ICMP path, not application proof.
host → DNS/name mapping.
IPv6 variants use ip -6 and ping -6.
Manual ip commands are educational but error-prone.
NetworkManager tracks devices/connections and orchestrates state.
nmcli shows state; nm-online reports online status.
nsswitch selects lookup sources; hosts may precede DNS.
resolv.conf may be generated; systemd-resolved can cache per-link DNS.
resolvectl status shows resolver configuration when applicable.
TCP = connection-oriented transport with ports.
UDP = datagrams with ports, no TCP-style connection/recovery.
netstat -nt shows active TCP connections.
netstat -ntl shows listening TCP ports.
DHCP automates IPv4 configuration; avoid competing servers.
IPv6 may use stateless autoconfiguration via router advertisements.
Multiple interfaces do not imply packet forwarding.
net.ipv4.ip_forward enables IPv4 routing.
Private IPv4 commonly uses NAT/MASQUERADE.
NAT examines more than IP addresses; transport ports matter.
IPv6 does not need NAT for address exhaustion workaround.
iptables chains are evaluated top-to-bottom.
First matching rule wins.
Default DROP requires explicit allowed traffic.
Rule order is part of security policy.
Remote-only restrictive changes can lock out admin access.
ARP maps local IPv4 neighbors to MAC.
NDP performs IPv6 neighbor discovery.
Remote traffic resolves the next-hop router MAC.
iw exposes scan/link/connect wireless state.
Use WPA2/WPA3 layer; source rejects WEP/old insecure WPA.

svg.text: Operational model: interface → address → route → neighbor → resolver → transport → application; change only after baseline.
